title: Shifting Up: y = f(x) + 3
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe how the graph of y=f(x)+3 relates to the graph of y=f(x).

steps.title: Interpret the Formula
steps.explanation: At every input the output gains 3, so each plotted height is raised by three units.
steps.why: Adding a constant outside the function acts purely vertically.

steps.title: Track a Typical Point
steps.explanation: Each point travels straight up by 3; x-coordinates are untouched.
steps.why: Vertical translations keep inputs fixed and add to all outputs.

steps.title: Describe the Sketch
steps.explanation: The shape is copied exactly at a height three units higher, so features such as intercepts move but the silhouette does not.
steps.why: Rigid translation preserves every distance and slope on the graph.
